slides.say: Props are great for passing data. Until you have to pass the same prop through layer after layer.
Lift state high enough, and the nearest common parent can be far from the components that need it.

steps.say: Layout and Sidebar do not use user. They only pass it along.
Only Avatar actually needs it. That chain of pass-through props is called prop drilling.

slides.text: Verbose and inconvenient, especially when many components need the same data.
slides.say: It gets verbose and inconvenient, especially when many components need the same data.

slides.text: Context lets a parent "teleport" data to the whole tree below it.
slides.say: Context is React’s way to teleport data to any component below, no matter how deep, without passing props.
